jobs.description: Job Description About Bluehive Most organizations do not struggle with tools. They struggle with how work actually flows.Too many processes, unclear ownership, and teams working next to each other instead of together.That is where Bluehive comes in.We help organizations bring structure into the way they work. Using platforms like Asana, but more importantly by designing workflows, aligning teams and making sure changes actually stick in practice.Bluehive is part of One Productivity Group, a pan-European group focused on improving how organizations operate. Across our brands, consulting, technology and execution come together to create better workflows, stronger collaboration and more scalable operations. About the role This role is for someone who enjoys understanding customer challenges, identifying opportunities and turning them into meaningful business relationships.As an Account Executive, you help organizations recognize where their current ways of working create friction and where better workflows, clearer structures and stronger collaboration can make a real difference. You guide prospects through that journey, from first conversation to closing, by combining commercial drive with a strong understanding of customer needs.The role sits at the intersection of business development, consultative sales and organizational improvement. You work closely with SDRs, consultants and solution colleagues to shape opportunities, build trust with stakeholders and help customers move confidently toward the right decision.It is a commercial role, but one built on substance, credibility and long-term value.Your mission What the role involves • Leading sales conversations with prospective customers and understanding how their current processes, tools and ways of working are set up • Identifying challenges around collaboration, ownership, structure and operational efficiency • Showing how Bluehive’s solutions can help organizations work in a more structured, aligned and scalable way • Managing opportunities independently throughout the full sales cycle, from qualification to negotiation and closing • Building relationships with internal champions, decision-makers and senior stakeholders across customer organizations • Working closely with SDRs, consultants and solution colleagues to shape strong and realistic solution directions • Guiding customers through decision-making processes with clarity, confidence and commercial ownership • Keeping pipeline, CRM data and sales information well structured and up to date • Creating repeatable and consistent ways of working that support predictable commercial results • Contributing to the further development of messaging, sales approaches and commercial best practicesYour profile What makes a strong fit • Several years of experience in sales, business development, account management or a similar commercial role • Ideally experience in SaaS, consulting, digital collaboration or solution-based selling • Strong communication and relationship-building skills • Confidence in speaking with different stakeholders, including senior decision-makers • A structured and disciplined way of working, with strong ownership and follow-through • The ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into commercially relevant opportunities • A proactive mindset and the ability to work independently in a dynamic environment • A high level of customer focus, credibility and professional presence • Fluent German and English, both spoken and written • Interest in work management, process improvement and modern collaboration tools such as Asana is a strong advantage What makes this role interesting Many sales roles focus mainly on volume, speed and short-term targets. This role goes further.It involves understanding how organizations actually operate, where collaboration breaks down and how better workflows and structures can create real improvement.That makes the conversations more meaningful, the sales process more consultative and the impact of the role more visible.Why One Productivity Group? What One Productivity Group offers • A role with real ownership and direct influence on customer growth and commercial success • The opportunity to work with well-known clients on meaningful collaboration and transformation challenges • An attractive compensation package with fixed salary and performance-based variable • A flexible setup, remote, hybrid or from one of our office locations • A professional onboarding and strong on-the-job learning environment • Regular coaching, feedback and development opportunities • A team that combines high standards with a collaborative and down-to-earth way of working • Room to bring in ideas, improve how things are done and contribute beyond the core role • A digital-first work culture with flexibility and trust • High-quality equipment for both office and remote work About One Productivity Group One Productivity Group is a fast-growing pan-European group focused on helping organizations improve the way they work. Across our brands, consulting, technology and execution come together to create better workflows, stronger collaboration and more scalable operations.We hire across Europe and work across multiple countries, including Germany, the Netherlands, Switzerland, France and Sweden. Our people work from offices in Berlin, Hamburg, Rotterdam, Paris and Stockholm, or fully remotely. This gives us the flexibility to bring together the right talent across markets while staying connected through shared standards, close collaboration and a strong team culture.There is a shared culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FORSynapticon builds the motion control and actuator technology at the core of next-generation robots and machines. Our SOMANET, Circulo and ACTILINK product lines integrate drives, sensors and control electronics into compact, highly efficient units, deployed in some of the most demanding robotics programmes globally.As Hardware Developer you will help create our next-generation robotic axis controller. Working closely with our firmware, functional safety and mechanics teams, you will design highly integrated servo electronics from first concept all the way to series production. Your challenge: designing hardware that works hand in hand with the firmware to be highly efficient, performant and economical.HERE'S WHERE YOU MAKE AN IMPACT• Design highly integrated power electronics for our next-generation robotic axis controller• Cover the full hardware development lifecycle: concept, schematic design, layout, board bring-up and testing• Collaborate closely with firmware, safety and mechanics engineers to optimise the overall system• Troubleshoot and validate prototypes in the lab• Drive designs from prototype to series production, with a focus on cost and manufacturability• Bring your own ideas to the table and push the limits of what our technology can doWHO YOU ARE• 3+ years of hands-on experience with mixed-signal designs and a strong understanding of basic electronics — the rest you can learn• Solid experience across the hardware development lifecycle, including schematic design, layout, board bring-up and testing• Confident with lab equipment and able to troubleshoot prototypes quickly• Strong experience with common tools such as Altium Designer and LTspice• Experience in EMC fundamentals, analog design, power electronics or manufacturing optimisation is a strong plus• Clear communicator — able to discuss ideas with colleagues and make your thinking understood• Passionate about technology and design creativity, with the drive to learn and grow quickly and to motivate those around you• Fluent in EnglishWHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU• A warm, international team that truly enjoys working together• Plenty of creative freedom and the opportunity to make a real impact• Flexible working hours and hybrid work options• Short decision-making paths, flat hierarchies, and open communication• Professional development opportunities and exciting projects• 30 days of paid vacation• Full-time position (40 hours/week) with a permanent contract• Company pension scheme through Dyno• Flexible working hours when life takes unexpected turns• Company-supported gym memberships through Wellpass• Snacks and fresh fruit for all employees, plus breakfast every Monday• Free drinks and coffee, of course• Regular global team-building events such as bootcamps, ski trips, and summer BBQs• Modern office spacesAbout us HACKING THE PHYSICS AND ECONOMICS OF MOTION CONTROL WITH DIGITAL TECHNOLOGYAt Synapticon, we are revolutionizing motion control for robotics and machines—right at the point of motion.Our approach is completely new: we integrate previously separate components such as motors, drives, sensors, and gearboxes into seamless units. At the same time, we are digitizing performance and quality factors that previously depended on expensive mechanical manufacturing.World-leading innovators are choosing Synapticon to pave their way into the future of intelligent, motion-controlled systems.Be part of our success story – apply now at Synapticon!

jobs.employer_name: Weierstraß-Institut für Angewandte Analysis und Stochastik (WIAS)
jobs.description: The Weierstrass Institute for Applied Analysis and Stochastics (WIAS) is an institute of the Forschungsverbund Berlin e.V. (FVB). The FVB comprises seven non-university research institutes in Berlin which are funded by the federal and state governments. The research institutes belong to the Leibniz Association.WIAS invites applications for aResearch Assistant Position (f/m/d)(Ref. 26/22)in the Research Group “Nonsmooth Variational Problems and Operator Equations”(Head: Prof. Dr. Michael Hintermüller),starting on January 1, 2027.Field of work:The successful candidate will work in the MATH+ project "DOC-TWIN: Duality-Based Error Control for Optimal Control Problems in Digital-Twin-Based Structural Health Monitoring". The project aims at developing a convex-duality-based framework for reliable error control in PDE-constrained optimal control problems motivated by digital-twin-based structural health monitoring.The Tasks include:- Developing and analyzing duality-based a posteriori error identities for PDE-constrained optimal control problems;- Deriving corresponding discrete a priori error identities and using them for convergence-rate analysis and certified nonlinear solver control;- Designing, implementing, and numerically validating finite element methods, including adaptive mesh-refinement strategies and suitable post-processing techniques;- Preparing scientific publications and presenting the results at workshops and conferences.**We are looking for: **Applicants with:- A very good university degree in mathematics, computational science, engineering, or a closely related field;- A strong interest in numerical analysis, optimization, partial differential equations, or scientific computing;- A willingness to work on both the mathematical analysis and the implementation of numerical methods for PDE-constrained optimization problems;- Good communication skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment;- Good written and spoken English skills.Desirable Qualifications:Experience in one or more of the following areas is an advantage but not a requirement:- Finite element methods, adaptive methods, or a posteriori error estimation;- Convex analysis, nonsmooth optimization, or optimal control;- PDE-constrained optimization or inverse problems;- Numerical methods for elasticity, structural mechanics, or related models;- Implementation of numerical methods in Python, MATLAB, Julia, C/C++, or finite element software.What we offer:- The opportunity to work at WIAS Berlin, a leading research institution with strengths in partial differential equations, mathematical modeling, nonlinear optimization, and applied mathematics in general;- The option of mobile working;- A certified family-friendly work environment (Audit berufundfamilie);- The opportunity to live and work in Berlin, one of the world's most culturally rich and diverse international cities. Berlin offers a wide range of opportunities to enjoy life outside work while remaining relatively affordable compared with other major cities. Neither the position nor living in Berlin requires knowledge of German, although WIAS offers free German courses. We particularly welcome international applicants. Berlin also offers a rich scientific landscape, with numerous research opportunities and career prospects in both academia and industry;- Close mentorship from the supervisor and other peers through a dedicated mentorship program.Please direct scientific queries to Prof Dr. Michael Hintermüller (michael.hintermueller@wias-berlin.de).The appointment is limited to two years. The position is full-time (39 hours per week), with a salary based on pay grade E 13 of the German TVöD Bund pay scale.WIAS is committed to fostering diversity and equal opportunities and particularly encourages women to apply. Applicants with disabilities will be given preferential consideration in cases of equal qualification. If you have any questions or want to provide us with information related to diversity, inclusion or disabilities, please feel free to consult our website orcontact our Diversity Officer, Sara Krummenacher (sara.krummenacher@wias-berlin.de).How to apply:Please upload your complete application documents (motivation letter, detailed CV, certificates, copy of the master thesis, etc.) via our applicant portal using the button “Apply online”.The application period opens immediately and remains open until the position is filled.We are looking forward to your application!

jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.comThe PositionHow can experimental dissolution science and digital approaches help us better understand the performance of tomorrow's oral medicines? We are seeking a curious and motivated Postdoc to join our Biopharmaceutics and Dissolution Sciences team in Biberach. You will lead a research project focused on advancing biopredictive dissolution approaches for challenging compounds and advanced oral formulations.Combining hands-on laboratory research, mechanistic interpretation and modern digital tools, you will explore how drug substance properties, formulation attributes and experimental conditions influence in vitro performance and support oral formulation development.Working with multidisciplinary experts and state-of-the-art technologies, you will build your independent research profile and gain experience in pharmaceutical development, with opportunities for peer-reviewed publications and international scientific exchange.Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.comThis position is limited for 2 years.This position is part time eligible with 80 %.Postdoc: This Position is limited for 2 years.Note: To make it easier to find our job advertisements, we use the usual designation "postdoc". Of course, this advertisement is not only addressed to applicants directly after completing their doctorate, but to all qualified candidates.Tasks & responsibilities- You independently design, conduct and evaluate studies to develop physiologically relevant, biopredictive dissolution approaches for challenging compounds and advanced oral formulations.- By investigating dissolution, supersaturation and precipitation, you derive mechanistic insights into how drug substance properties, formulation attributes, manufacturing variables and test conditions influence in vitro performance.- Building on these insights, you apply the developed approaches to drug development questions and critically assess their applicability and limitations.- Your findings enable you to develop practical recommendations and best practices for oral drug product development.- Using digital, data-driven and computational tools, you analyze complex datasets and support evidence-based decisions.- As part of a multidisciplinary environment, you collaborate with experts in formulation development, biopharmaceutics, pharmacokinetics, modeling and regulatory sciences.- Through scientific reports, peer-reviewed publications and presentations, you communicate your research findings to internal teams and at international conferences.Requirements- PhD in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Food Science or a related discipline.- Hands-on experience in dissolution testing, oral formulation development, biopharmaceutics or a related experimental field. Experience with poorly soluble compounds, amorphous solid dispersions, supersaturation or precipitation is advantageous.- Experience in analytical method development using techniques such as HPLC/UPLC, UV spectroscopy or comparable methods. Experience with solid-state or particle characterization, imaging or laboratory automation is advantageous.- Sound understanding of oral drug absorption and its relationship to drug substance properties, formulation performance and gastrointestinal conditions. Knowledge of physiologically relevant dissolution testing, IVIVR/IVIVC, PBBM/PBPK modeling or regulatory biopharmaceutics is advantageous.- Ability to independently plan and conduct experiments, critically analyze complex datasets and draw clear scientific conclusions. Interest or experience in computational tools, scientific informatics, knowledge management or AI-enabled knowledge discovery is desirable. Experience with statistical data analysis is advantageous.- Scientific curiosity, a proactive and well-organized working style, and the ability to collaborate across disciplines and functions. Excellent scientific communication, presentation and technical writing skills in English. German language skills are advantageous but not required.As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comIf you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 11, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to November 04, 2026 are guaranteed to be considered.Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from mid of November till end of NovemberStep 3: On-site interviews beginning mid of DecemberPlease include the following documents when applying for this position: Certificates and Documentation.

Purpose of your JobOur Science and Technology team is looking for a Modelling Scientist to advance data-driven drug development through cutting-edge computational approaches.In this role, you will apply mechanistic models, machine learning, and molecular simulations to predict the stability and behaviour of biopharmaceutical products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate modelling into experimental workflows and support innovative, model-informed development strategies.Are you passionate about scientific modelling and pharmaceutical innovation?Join us and shape the future of computational drug development—apply today!Your Responsibility- Act as a scientific contributor in cross-functional research and development projects, supporting the integration of advanced modelling approaches into biopharmaceutical development.- Develop, validate, and apply advanced computational models to simulate the physical and chemicals stability, as well as the behaviour, of biopharmaceutical drug products.- Integrate experimental and structural data into predictive modelling frameworks.- Utilize a range of modelling techniques, including mechanistic models, machine learning approaches, and molecular simulations, to generate actionable scientific insights.- Contribute to the development of internal modelling platforms, tools, and workflows to enhance scalability and reproducibility.- Design and execute simulation studies to investigate formulations parameters, degradation pathways, and process related risks.- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including formulation scientists, analytical experts, and business developers to align modelling strategies with project objectives.- Analyse and interpret complex data to generate actionable insights.- Translate and present complex modelling outcomes into clear, impactful recommendations for internal stakeholders and project teams.- Ensure model quality through rigorous validation procedures and documentation, following internal standards and regulatory expectations where applicable.- Drive continuous innovation by exploring and implementing state-of-the-art computational approaches relevant to pharmaceutical formulation science.- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of developments in computational modelling, data science, and biopharmaceutical development to ensure the scientific relevance and competitiveness of modelling approaches.- Contribute to scientific excellence by co-authoring peer-reviewed publications.- Support regulatory submissions by providing modelling data and documentation as needed.What you need to succeed- Master’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field (PhD preferred)- Formal training or academic coursework in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, bioinformatics, or molecular dynamics is advantageous.- 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical research and computational modelling, ideally with exposure to protein- and nucleic acid-based therapeutics.- Strong programming and data analysis skills, with proficiency in tools such as Python, MATLAB, or R, and familiarity with modelling and simulation libraries.- Expertise in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, molecular modelling, or molecular dynamics simulations.- Solid understanding of biopharmaceutical products, including structure-function relationships, degradation mechanisms, and formulation challenges.- Experience in integrating computational models into experimental workflows and interdisciplinary project settings.- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of scientific contributions such as peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations.- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex modelling results into clear insights for diverse audiences.- Fluency in English, both written and spoken.- Collaborative and team-oriented mindset with a proactive and open approach to interdisciplinary work.- A passion for scientific innovation, curiosity, and a commitment to staying at the forefront of computational and pharmaceutical science.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Modellbildung, Simulation (IT)Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Data Fabric, Molekularbiologie, Modellierungs- und Simulationssprache SystemC, Arzneimittelinformation, Galenik, Angewandte Informatik, KI-Detektoren, MathematikExpertenkenntnisse: Data Engineering, Quantitative Forschungsmethode, Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Programmiersprache R, Bioinformatik, Angewandte Mathematik, Biomathematik, Datenvisualisierung, Data Science, Machine
